assumptions_metadata.task_description: Curate and render weekly featured film cards for a streaming platform by ranking titles with IMDb ratings and vote volume and displaying each film’s poster, runtime, and age certificate.

assumptions.assumption: The pair (Series_Title, Released_Year) is unique across the table.
Poster_Link must be a valid HTTPS URL (starts with 'https://').
Parsed runtime minutes must be between 45 and 240 inclusive.
If Genre contains 'Horror', Certificate must not be 'U' or 'G'.
If Genre contains 'Family' or 'Animation', Certificate must not be 'R', 'NC-17', or 'A'.
IMDB_Rating must be between 0.0 and 10.0 inclusive.

result.code:
import argparse import os import re import json import pandas as pd import numpy as np parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True) parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True) args = parser.parse_args() input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv') os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True) df = pd.read_csv(input_csv) # Basic dtype normalization used by ranking and rendering df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce') df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce') # ASSERTION_START assert not df.duplicated(subset=['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).any() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START rating_ok = df['IMDB_Rating'].notna() & df['IMDB_Rating'].between(0.0, 10.0, inclusive='both') votes_ok = df['No_of_Votes'].notna() & (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 1000) assert rating_ok.all() and votes_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END # Compute a weighted ranking using a Bayesian-style formula v = df['No_of_Votes'] r = df['IMDB_Rating'] C = r.mean() m = float(v.quantile(0.60)) if not np.isfinite(m) or m <= 0: m = 1000.0 score = (v / (v + m)) * r + (m / (v + m)) * C df['ranking_score'] = score # Pick weekly featured titles TOP_N = 12 featured = df.sort_values(['ranking_score', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=[False, False, False]).head(TOP_N).copy() # ASSERTION_START assert featured['Poster_Link'].astype(str).str.startswith('https://', na=False).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START pattern_ok = featured['Runtime'].astype(str).str.match(r'^\d+\smin$', na=False) mins = featured['Runtime'].astype(str).str.extract(r'^(\d+)\smin$')[0].astype(float) range_ok = mins.ge(45) & mins.le(240) assert pattern_ok.all() and range_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START horror_mask = featured['Genre'].astype(str).str.contains('Horror', case=False, na=False) cert_upper = featured['Certificate'].astype(str).str.upper() assert (~(horror_mask & cert_upper.isin(['U', 'G']))).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START fam_anim_mask = featured['Genre'].astype(str).str.contains('Family|Animation', case=False, regex=True, na=False) cert_upper = featured['Certificate'].astype(str).str.upper() assert (~(fam_anim_mask & cert_upper.isin(['R', 'NC-17', 'A']))).all() # ASSERTION_END # Parse runtime minutes for display and layout featured['runtime_minutes'] = featured['Runtime'].str.extract(r'(\d+)')[0].astype(int) # Prepare rendering data def slugify(text: str) -> str: base = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', text.strip()).strip('-') return base.lower() cards = [] for row in featured.itertuples(index=False): title = str(getattr(row, 'Series_Title')) year = int(getattr(row, 'Released_Year')) if pd.notna(getattr(row, 'Released_Year')) else None poster = str(getattr(row, 'Poster_Link')) runtime_min = int(getattr(row, 'runtime_minutes')) certificate = getattr(row, 'Certificate') certificate_display = 'NR' if pd.isna(certificate) or str(certificate).strip() == '' else str(certificate) rating_val = float(getattr(row, 'IMDB_Rating')) votes_val = int(getattr(row, 'No_of_Votes')) score_val = float(getattr(row, 'ranking_score')) slug = slugify(f"{title}-{year}") star_fill_pct = max(0.0, min(100.0, rating_val * 10.0)) cards.append({ 'id': slug, 'title': title, 'year': year, 'poster': poster, 'runtime_minutes': runtime_min, 'certificate': certificate_display, 'imdb_rating': rating_val, 'votes': votes_val, 'score': score_val, 'genre': str(getattr(row, 'Genre')), 'star_fill_pct': star_fill_pct }) # Render a simple HTML page with cards style = """ """ cards_html_parts = [] for c in cards: card_html = f"""
{c['title']} ({c['year']})
{c['genre']}
{c['runtime_minutes']} min {c['certificate']}
{c['imdb_rating']:.1f} • {c['votes']:,} votes
""" cards_html_parts.append(card_html) html = f""" Weekly Featured Films {style}

Weekly Featured Films

{''.join(cards_html_parts)}
""" with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'featured_cards.html'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(html) with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'featured_cards.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump({'generated_by': 'curation_pipeline', 'count': len(cards), 'items': cards}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
